digest.component_or_area: LLM usage logging and GitHub Actions weekly jobs
propositions: The two weekly GitHub Actions jobs (external-integration.yml and prompt-eval.yml) that make live LLM calls have no retrievable record of token usage despite the runner already computing and attaching usage data as _usage in results

Token usage (input/output/cache tokens and request count) is computed in PydanticAIRunner.run at runner.py:392,394 and logged at runner.py:452-470, but this record does not surface to either job because the eval path drops _usage, pytest tier surfaces nothing, and NullHandler suppresses INFO logs
A new opt-in process-level usage sink must be added at the _usage seam in PydanticAIRunner.run to capture usage when REBAR_USAGE_LOG environment variable is set

The usage_log module must provide record(usage, op) to append JSONL lines and summarize(path) to generate Markdown summary; both functions must be no-op or graceful when REBAR_USAGE_LOG is unset or path is missing
Both weekly jobs must set REBAR_USAGE_LOG, invoke usage_log summarize after test/eval steps with if:always(), append output to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, and upload raw JSONL as artifact
